# Taylor & Francis Online
> Taylor & Francis Online is the publisher platform for accessing scholarly journals, books, articles, and open research content across disciplines.

The platform provides journal and book discovery, article access, citation tools, author guidance, librarian resources, and open access publishing information for researchers, educators, and institutions.

## Platform and Search
- [Home](https://www.tandfonline.com/): Main entry point for journal, article, and book discovery across the platform.
- [Search Results](https://www.tandfonline.com/action/doSearch): Search interface for articles, journals, books, and other scholarly content.
- [Browse Publications](https://www.tandfonline.com/action/showPublications): Browse all available journals and publications by title and subject.
- [Subjects](https://www.tandfonline.com/subject): Explore content organized by academic discipline and research area.
- [Latest Articles](https://www.tandfonline.com/toc/current): Access current issue tables of contents and newly published journal content.

## Journals and Issues
- [Journals A-Z](https://www.tandfonline.com/action/showPublications?pubType=journal): Browse the complete journal catalog alphabetically.
- [Current Issue](https://www.tandfonline.com/toc/current): View current journal issues and recently released articles.
- [List of Issues](https://www.tandfonline.com/loi): Navigate journal issue archives and publication history.
- [Journal Overview Pages](https://www.tandfonline.com/journal): Landing pages for individual journals with aims, scope, and access options.
- [Table of Contents](https://www.tandfonline.com/toc): Issue-level contents pages for journals and serial publications.

## Articles and Content Access
- [Article Pages](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/): Full-text article pages with abstract, references, metrics, and citation tools.
- [Article Abstract Pages](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/abs/): Abstract-only article pages with metadata and access information.
- [PDF Articles](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/pdf/): Downloadable PDF versions of published articles where access is available.
- [EPUB Articles](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/epub/): EPUB article format for supported content and reading workflows.
- [Figures and Data](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/figure/): Figure-level views and associated visual content for articles.
- [Supplementary Materials](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/suppl/): Supplemental files and appendices associated with published research.

## Books and Reference Works
- [Books A-Z](https://www.tandfonline.com/action/showPublications?pubType=book): Browse books and reference works available on the platform.
- [Book Series](https://www.tandfonline.com/book-series): Explore scholarly book series and related publication collections.
- [Book Chapters](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.4324/): Access chapter-level content hosted with DOI-based landing pages.
- [Open Access Books](https://www.tandfonline.com/openaccess/books): Discover openly accessible books and chapters.
- [Reference Content](https://www.tandfonline.com/reference-work): Access reference works and encyclopedic scholarly resources.

## Open Access and Open Research
- [Open Access Hub](https://www.tandfonline.com/openaccess): Overview of open access publishing and reading options on the platform.
- [Open Journals and Articles](https://www.tandfonline.com/openaccess/openjournals): Browse open access journals and openly available article content.
- [Open Select](https://www.tandfonline.com/openaccess/openselect): Information on hybrid open access publishing options for authors.
- [Open Research](https://www.tandfonline.com/openresearch): Explore open research policies, workflows, and related publishing support.
- [Open Access Books](https://www.tandfonline.com/openaccess/books): Information and discovery for open access books and chapters.

## Authors and Publishing Support
- [Instructions for Authors](https://authorservices.taylorandfrancis.com/publishing-your-research/choosing-a-journal/instructions-for-authors/): Guidance for preparing and submitting manuscripts to Taylor & Francis journals.
- [Author Services](https://authorservices.taylorandfrancis.com/): Central hub for manuscript preparation, submission, peer review, and publication support.
- [Publishing Your Research](https://authorservices.taylorandfrancis.com/publishing-your-research/): End-to-end guidance for authors from journal selection to publication.
- [Open Access for Authors](https://authorservices.taylorandfrancis.com/open-research/open-access/): Author-focused explanation of open access routes, policies, and funding.
- [Permissions](https://authorservices.taylorandfrancis.com/permissions/): Information on reuse rights, permissions requests, and licensing questions.

## Librarians and Institutional Access
- [Librarian Resources](https://librarianresources.taylorandfrancis.com/): Support hub for librarians managing subscriptions, access, and discovery services.
- [Account and Access Support](https://help.tandfonline.com/): Help center for login, institutional access, and platform troubleshooting.
- [Usage Statistics](https://librarianresources.taylorandfrancis.com/collection-management/usage-statistics/): Guidance on obtaining and interpreting institutional usage reports.
- [Discovery and Metadata](https://librarianresources.taylorandfrancis.com/collection-management/discovery-services/): Information on metadata delivery and discovery service integration.
- [Open Access Agreements](https://librarianresources.taylorandfrancis.com/open-access/open-access-agreements/): Details on institutional open access agreements and eligibility.

## Help and Account Management
- [Help Center](https://help.tandfonline.com/): Support articles for access, searching, citations, and account issues.
- [Contact Us](https://help.tandfonline.com/contact-support/): Contact options for technical support and customer service inquiries.
- [Register](https://www.tandfonline.com/action/registration): Create a personal account for alerts, saved searches, and purchases.
- [Sign In](https://www.tandfonline.com/action/showLogin): Sign in to personal or institutional accounts on the platform.
- [My Account](https://www.tandfonline.com/action/showPreferences): Manage profile settings, alerts, saved items, and account preferences.

## Citation, Metrics, and Tools
- [Citation Tools](https://www.tandfonline.com/action/showCitFormats): Export citations in common reference management formats.
- [Article Metrics](https://www.tandfonline.com/action/showMetrics): View usage, citation, and attention indicators for individual articles.
- [Recommend to Librarian](https://www.tandfonline.com/action/showRecommendToLibrarian): Submit publication recommendations for institutional library acquisition.
- [Get Access](https://www.tandfonline.com/action/showLogin?redirectUri=): Access and authentication flow for subscribed or purchased content.
- [Alerts and Saved Searches](https://www.tandfonline.com/action/showPreferences): Manage content alerts and saved discovery preferences.

## Policies and Legal
- [Terms and Conditions](https://www.tandfonline.com/action/termsAndConditions): Terms governing use of the platform and hosted content.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.tandfonline.com/action/privacyPolicy): Privacy practices for user data, cookies, and account information.
- [Cookies](https://www.tandfonline.com/action/cookiePolicy): Information about cookie usage and consent choices on the site.
- [Accessibility](https://www.tandfonline.com/action/accessibilityStatement): Accessibility statement covering platform standards and support.
- [Rights and Permissions](https://authorservices.taylorandfrancis.com/permissions/): Policies and workflows for content reuse and permissions requests.
